Description.header: Reports completed files placed in a shared staging directory.
Description.body: Copy files through the returned request-local input directory link. Read JSON-Line batches continuously from events, then write a non-empty message to seal after the producer finishes. The processor also seals after WaitQueryUpdateTimeoutSec without a newly observed filesystem entity. The result FIFO returns one final summary after sealing. Files remain in staging and are not copied to /uploads.
Description.footer: Producers should atomically rename completed files into input. The events writer stays connected and emits a terminated event before EOF.
